Heard Sri Mohd. Abid Ali Advocate holding brief of Sri Irshad Ahmad, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Varun Kumar Agnihotri, learned brief holder for the State-respondent.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicants on bail in Case Crime No. 153 of 2013 , under Sections 307, 420 IPC & 3/5A/8 U.P. Cow Slaughter Act, 1955 & 11 Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960, Police Station- Hazrat Nagar Garhi, District- Sambhal, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicants were made accused in the present matter in the year 2013 and thereafter they were released on bail and they attended the Trial Court regularly till 28.5.2019 but thereafter they could not appear before the Court concerned as applicants went to Punjab for their livelihood.
He further submitted that in the month of March, 2020 Covid-19 pandemic broke out in the country and thereafter applicants could not appear before the Court concerned.
He further submitted that applicants were not wilfully absent from the Court proceedings.

sentences.text: He further submitted that applicants are in jail in since 13.1.2023.
Per contra, learned AGA although, opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that applicants appeared in the Trial Court till May, 2019.
I have heard both the parties and perused the record of the case.

From the perusal of the record it appears that applicants were made accused in the present matter in the year 2013 and thereafter they have been released on bail and they continuously appeared before the Trial Court till May, 2019 but thereafter they remained absent.

As per the defence taken by the applicants, they went to Punjab for their livelihood and thereafter Covid-19 pandemic broke out in the country, therefore, they could not appear before the court concerned.

Therefore, considering the defence taken by the applicants and the fact that applicants continuously attended the Trial Court till May, 2019 after release on bail, in my view applicants are released on bail.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

Let the applicants- Mohd. Subhan and Farhan be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicants shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicants shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicants shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicants.
